subject: Following up on the access concern
text: Thank you for contacting me about the gate access concern. As the neighbor affected by the repair window, I understand the tight deadline left the crew working after hours. That said, I could not give prior notice because the work order changed during the morning. I will clear the side path by eight tomorrow, store the ladder in the garage, and remind guests to avoid the front drive. Please send confirmation when the final inspection occurs, so I can leave a small note for the street committee.
